title: Agent Node Entity
description: JSON Schema for Agent node entity (workflows/{workflow_id}/agents/{id}.json). AI model invocation node in the streaming pipeline. Bounds match graph-patch-apply validateAgentNodePayload. additionalProperties stays open because AgentNodeEntity ([key: string]: unknown) and graph patch node_config carry runtime-specific keys; known fields are typed and required fields are enforced.

agent_node_id.description: Unique identifier for the agent node

workflow_id.description: Workflow this agent node belongs to

prompt_template.description: Prompt template rendered with the event payload (1-10000 characters)

output_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema for the model output (at most 50KB serialized)

upstream_entity_id.description: Upstream node in the workflow graph

upstream_entity_type.description: Entity type of the upstream node

upstream_label.description: Labelled edge from the upstream node (approval branches)

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the node was created

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the node was last updated
